name: Zadarma
description: Zadarma telephony API for balance, prices, SIP lines, callback calls, SMS, direct numbers, PBX records, statistics, and PBX webhooks. Uses Zadarma's signed Authorization header.

credential_fields.name: api_secret
credential_fields.label: API Secret
credential_fields.description: Zadarma API secret used to sign requests.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get Zadarma account balance.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get call price for a number/direction.

tools.name: list_tariffs
tools.description: List Zadarma tariffs.

tools.name: list_sip
tools.description: List SIP accounts.

tools.name: get_sip_status
tools.description: Get a SIP account status.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Start a callback call between two phone numbers/SIP endpoints.

tools.name: check_number
tools.description: Validate or check number availability/format through Zadarma.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS through Zadarma.

tools.name: list_sms_templates
tools.description: List SMS templates.

tools.name: list_sender_ids
tools.description: List SMS sender IDs.

tools.name: list_direct_numbers
tools.description: List purchased direct numbers.

tools.name: get_direct_number
tools.description: Get details for a direct number.

tools.name: list_direct_number_countries
tools.description: List countries/directions where Zadarma direct numbers can be ordered.

tools.name: list_available_direct_numbers
tools.description: List available direct numbers for a direction ID.

tools.name: order_direct_number
tools.description: Order a Zadarma direct number.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Get call statistics.

tools.name: get_pbx_callinfo
tools.description: Get PBX call information.

tools.name: request_pbx_record
tools.description: Request a PBX call recording link.

tools.name: list_pbx_webhooks
tools.description: List PBX webhook settings.

tools.name: set_pbx_webhook_url
tools.description: Set PBX webhook URL.

tools.name: set_pbx_webhook_hooks
tools.description: Configure PBX webhook event hooks.

tools.name: list_direct_number_directions
tools.description: List destinations, prices, requirements, and capabilities for a country.

tools.name: prolong_direct_number
tools.description: Prepay and extend an owned virtual number for a number of months.

tools.name: get_direct_number_autoprolongation
tools.description: Get automatic-renewal status for an owned virtual number.

tools.name: set_direct_number_autoprolongation
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic renewal for an owned virtual number.

tools.name: set_direct_number_caller_name
tools.description: Set or clear the caller-name label for an owned virtual number.

tools.name: route_direct_number
tools.description: Route an owned number to a SIP login or external SIP URI, optionally in test mode.

tools.name: list_document_groups
tools.description: List customer/company document groups used to satisfy number identity requirements.

tools.name: get_document_group
tools.description: Get a document group; group 0 is the main account group.

tools.name: create_document_group
tools.description: Create a customer or company document group for number registration.

tools.name: update_document_group
tools.description: Update registration details in a document group.

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Upload an identity or business document into a document group.

file.description: Document as base64, data URL, or binary envelope.

tools.name: list_document_files
tools.description: List uploaded identity/business documents, optionally by document group.

tools.name: validate_document_group
tools.description: Check whether a document group satisfies the requirements for a number direction.

tools.name: get_pbx_statistics
tools.description: Get PBX call statistics. Prefer PBX webhooks for near-real-time processing because this endpoint has a strict rate limit.

tools.name: get_speech_recognition
tools.description: Get speech-recognition results for a recorded call.

tools.name: request_speech_recognition
tools.description: Request speech recognition for a recorded call.
